metadata.title: Seedance 2.5 — 30-Second One-Take AI Video with Sound | Oddbeam
metadata.description: Seedance 2.5 on Oddbeam renders a full 30-second single take with native audio: Shot 1/Shot 2 multi-shot scripting, up to 50 multimodal references, timestamp direction, and region editing. 160 credits per generation.

hero.title: Seedance 2.5 Video Generator
hero.description: One take beats four stitched clips. Seedance 2.5 is ByteDance's flagship video model: a single generation renders up to 30 continuous seconds with dialogue, ambience, and music already in sync — no assembly required. Script multi-shot sequences, attach up to 50 references, and fix single regions without re-rolling the whole scene.

usage.title: One Prompt to a Shot List
usage.description: Seedance 2.5 reads a script, not just a vibe — here is the workflow:

items.title: Script Your Shots
items.description: Write Shot 1:, Shot 2:, Shot 3: in one prompt and direct the sequence like a storyboard — the model stages each beat in order while characters, lighting, and camera language carry across cuts.

items.title: Attach Up to 50 References
items.description: Feed as many as 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audio files into one job. Each reference can pin a character identity, a product appearance, a camera style, or even the pacing of the whole clip.

items.title: Set Length, Resolution, and Sound
items.description: Choose 4 to 30 seconds, 480p / 720p / 1080p, and toggle generate_audio on for synchronized dialogue and effects baked into the render.

items.title: Fix Beats, Not Whole Scenes
items.description: Wrong action at second 11? Direct a change at that timestamp or edit a single region in place — timing, composition, and audio stay untouched, so you stop paying for full re-rolls.

features.title: Why Seedance 2.5 Is the Longest Take on Oddbeam
features.description: Four upgrades over Seedance 2.0 that change how a shot gets made:

items.title: A full 30 seconds in one take
items.description: Twice the single-generation length of Seedance 2.0's 15 seconds — a complete ad spot or story beat renders as one continuous shot with no stitching and no continuity breaks.

items.title: Native audio in 10+ languages
items.description: Dialogue, music, and ambient sound are generated with the picture, and lip-sync holds across English, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and more — the VO pass disappears from your schedule.

items.title: 50 reference slots with roles
items.description: Characters, products, motion, and voice each get pinned by a dedicated reference — the consistency complaint that plagues AI video is solved at the input stage, not in post.

items.title: Timestamp-level direction
items.description: Write what happens at second 4, second 11, second 20. The model follows your timing instead of interpreting the whole prompt at once, which cuts re-rolls on precise beats.

items.title: Region editing in place
items.description: Swap a product, fix a label, or change a costume inside a finished clip while everything else — motion, lighting, audio — stays exactly as rendered.

testimonials.title: Built for Take-Based Production
testimonials.description: How teams put the 30-second take to work.

items.name: Ad Studio Lead
items.quote: A 30-second spot with dialogue and music used to be a two-day pipeline. With Seedance 2.5 it is one prompt with a shot list, and the Unlimited plan's 80-credit rate makes daily output normal.

items.name: Vertical Drama Director
items.quote: We pin the lead actor with one reference image and the character holds across every episode. First/last frame control gives us clean act breaks between clips.

items.name: Music Video Editor
items.quote: Dropping an audio reference in drives the pacing of the whole cut — camera changes land on the beat without me timing anything by hand.

items.question: How much does Seedance 2.5 cost per video?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 costs 160 credits per generation at the standard rate on Oddbeam. Unlimited plan subscribers pay 80 credits per clip, and yearly Unlimited brings it to 64. The Starter plan at $29.99 per month includes 2,500 credits — enough for about 15 Seedance 2.5 clips.

items.question: How long can one Seedance 2.5 clip be?
items.answer: A single generation renders 4 to 30 seconds — the longest single take available on Oddbeam. Because the 30 seconds are one continuous pass, characters, lighting, and audio stay consistent from first frame to last instead of resetting at every stitch point.

items.question: How does multi-shot scripting work in Seedance 2.5?
items.answer: Structure your prompt as Shot 1:, Shot 2:, Shot 3: and describe each beat with its camera move. Seedance 2.5 stages the sequence in order with natural cuts, keeping the same cast, wardrobe, and visual style across every shot in the take.

items.question: How many references can Seedance 2.5 take, and what do they do?
items.answer: Up to 50 files in one job — as many as 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audio tracks. Images pin characters and products, videos pin camera language and motion, and an audio reference can drive pacing, beat-matching, and lip-sync for the entire clip.

items.question: Does Seedance 2.5 generate dialogue and lip-sync?
items.answer: Yes. Toggle generate_audio and the model produces dialogue, ambience, and effects synchronized to the picture, with lip-sync supporting more than 10 languages including English, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish.

items.question: Seedance 2.5 or Seedance 2.0 — which should I pick?
items.answer: Pick 2.5 for length, references, and editing: 30-second takes, 50 reference slots, and region-level edits at 160 credits per clip. Pick 2.0 for budget work at 80 credits, or when you need its higher-resolution 4K output on shorter 4-15 second clips.
